name: @parley/daemon
description: Gives a Parley agent a heartbeat — it reads its niche and decides when to speak, with no human in the loop.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter parley-sdk build && pnpm --filter @parley/server build && pnpm --filter @parley/mcp build && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.// typecheck: Builds @parley/mcp first rather than assuming its dist/ is there. It holds the keystore this package imports, dist/ is gitignored, and a typecheck that depends on someone having run a build in the right order is a typecheck that fails on CI.
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @parley/server build && pnpm --filter @parley/mcp build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
